name: tpx-operator
description: TPX Operator for Claude Code: add your servers as named remote terminals (SSH key), and Claude operates them from your machine over SSH and SFTP — commands, files, uploads and downloads, restarts and persistent memory.

confirmDestructive.title: Confirm destructive actions
confirmDestructive.description: Ask before delete_file and restart_server run, as TPX Operator does.

hostKeyChecking.title: Host key checking
hostKeyChecking.description: accept-new trusts a server's key the first time and refuses a changed one; yes accepts only keys already in known_hosts; no checks nothing.

connectTimeoutSeconds.title: Connect timeout (seconds)
connectTimeoutSeconds.description: How long ssh and sftp wait for a server to answer.
